scope: Six fresh paired trajectories; same existing knowledge, no new method. Separate from historical course27 and previous cohorts.
historical_commands: Review all6 knowledge snapshots against matched-existing archive; preexecution-review.json records exact equality

environment.dependencies: pyproject.toml and uv.lock in source package; released upstream versions pinned in configs/benchmark.lock.json

credential_handling: Untracked local .env used by experiment launcher; no credentials packaged. Never put keys in command lines or chat.
accounting: No total cap, limit_usd=null and no max_price. Ledger records every request. Per-agent12rounds/4096tokens remain identical across arms as controlled conditions.
future_execution: Use a new output and ledger path, newly freeze the protocol, then execute. Existing outputs are immutable; no resume or repeat to replace failed/low-score cells.
limits: One exposed replication percondition, no broad generalization or causality
Generated Python parsed/static-inspected only; never executed
Chart data and units verified; rendering not verified
Archived upstreamsource is explanatory evidence only; no benchmark implementation fixed or rerun
Research not promoted; no new main push, sharedSlides edit or deployment
